facts.fact: The record says the World Broadband Association's case study states the National Broadband Network was deployed in 2019: 420 km of fibre-optic links and access networks around 31 central office sites, extending the 2015 ECOWAN backbone, owned and operated by GAMTEL; in July 2020 the minister said the network is earning.

note: Loan signed 2017-12-22 (US$25.9m, China Eximbank) is money, not a construction contract: no building fact.
